dtc.priority: Audit each client's Shopify Agentic Storefront status (now on by default across ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI Mode and Gemini) and confirm product feeds, structured data and referral attribution are clean — this is the single highest-leverage AI-visibility lever live right now and most founders don't know it's already running.

landscape.headline: Agentic Storefronts now default — products surface in ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI Mode & Gemini
landscape.body: Since March 2026 Shopify merchants' products are discoverable in major AI assistants by default, managed from Shopify Admin with no separate apps and no extra transaction fees. Orders carry ChatGPT referral attribution. Shopify reports AI-driven traffic up ~8x YoY and orders from AI search up ~15x since Jan 2025. This is the core surface our AEO work optimizes for.

landscape.headline: Sitecore acquires Scrunch for ~$225M — AI-search visibility consolidates upmarket
landscape.body: Sitecore is folding Scrunch's AI customer-experience / Agent Experience Platform into its enterprise DXP. Signals that enterprise budget is flowing into AI-visibility and that point tools are getting absorbed — leaves the founder-led $200K–$2M DTC segment underserved by the consolidating enterprise players. Deal value ~$225M [reported by Bloomberg, per PRNewswire].

landscape.headline: Profound cements lead as enterprise AI-visibility platform on $35M Sequoia Series B
landscape.body: Profound now monitors 10+ engines (ChatGPT/GPT-5.2, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek, Grok). Ahrefs has entered with Brand Radar AI-visibility features. Tooling is maturing fast at the top — our edge stays in done-for-you execution for founders who won't run an enterprise dashboard themselves.

landscape.headline: AI Overviews reshape transactional clicks — higher conversion, fewer clicks
landscape.body: 2026 data cited across roundups: AI Overviews drive ~34% higher conversion on transactional queries while overall CTR drops ~34.5% when an AI summary appears. Implication for DTC: being the cited source inside the answer matters more than blue-link rank. [stat sources are secondary roundups — treat as directional, not audited]

topIdea.label: Productized service
topIdea.title: Agentic Storefront Readiness Sprint for Shopify DTC founders
topIdea.body: A fixed-scope 2-week audit + remediation: validate Agentic Storefront is live, clean product feeds and structured/schema data, fix attribution, and benchmark citation share across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI Mode. Lands squarely on the default rollout most founders haven't acted on. Recurring monitoring upsell after the sprint.

cannabis.priority: Brief clients that the April 2026 Schedule III move does NOT unlock AI visibility or open SMS/ad channels — engines still refuse ~28% of cannabis prompts. Prioritize compliant, citation-ready owned content (lab data, education, structured product info) over any assumption that rescheduling loosens marketing rules.

landscape.source: Cannabis Business Times / CaNORML / Shay Gilmore Law
landscape.headline: Federal Schedule III order in effect; expedited adult-use hearing opens June 29
landscape.body: An April 22, 2026 order moved FDA-approved and state-regulated medical cannabis from Schedule I to Schedule III. An expedited administrative hearing begins June 29, 2026 on whether broader rescheduling (incl. adult-use) follows; state-licensed medical operators can seek expedited DEA registration through June 27, 2026. Material shift in the federal backdrop, but adult-use marketing constraints remain.

landscape.source: MG Magazine / 5W AI Visibility Index — Cannabis (May 2026)
landscape.headline: Schedule III won't fix AI visibility — ~28% of cannabis prompts still get refused or hedged
landscape.body: 5W's Q1 2026 index (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews; 50+ consumer-intent prompts) found ~28% of cannabis prompts produce AI refusals, hedges or prominent disclaimers — the highest of any consumer category. MSOs Curaleaf, Trulieve and Green Thumb captured ~17.5% of category citations; Cookies leads branded products; Charlotte's Web holds the #1 CBD slot. Citation share is highly concentrated.

landscape.headline: California DCC streamlines A/M license designation changes
landscape.body: In response to federal rescheduling, the DCC announced a streamlined process letting cultivation licensees change adult-use (A) / medicinal (M) designation without waiting for renewal. Operationally relevant for CA clients repositioning toward medical channels post-Schedule III. [confirm exact effective date per client before advising]

landscape.source: TCPA / FCC SMS rule coverage (Greenspoon Marder, cannabisregulations.ai)
landscape.headline: One-to-one consent + fast revocation keep SMS a legal minefield for cannabis
landscape.body: FCC's one-to-one consent rule (Jan 27, 2025) and mandatory fast opt-out/revocation (Apr 11, 2025) remain in force; carriers still largely block promotional cannabis SMS and 10DLC registration is required. TCPA exposure runs $500–$1,500 per message in class actions. Reinforces shifting acquisition spend from SMS blasts toward compliant owned/AI-discoverable content.

topIdea.label: Compliant content engine
topIdea.title: Citation-Ready Compliance Content for cannabis & CBD brands
topIdea.body: Build the owned, fact-dense assets AI engines will actually cite without tripping refusal filters: lab/COA data, dosing and safety education, structured product schema, and authority pages — engineered to win share in the ~72% of prompts engines do answer. Sidesteps the SMS/ad restrictions entirely by competing on credibility.

competitors.name: 5W PR / agencies publishing AI-visibility indices
competitors.changed: Released the Cannabis AI Visibility Index (May 2026), claiming the measurement high ground.
competitors.howToWin: Convert their published benchmarks into per-client gap analyses and done-for-you remediation — own the execution layer they only measure.

competitors.name: Alpine IQ & Springbig (dispensary CRM/SMS platforms)

competitors.howToWin: Position AI-visibility/GEO as the complement to (not replacement for) their CRM — capture demand they create but can't serve as SMS deliverability degrades; pitch the compliant top-of-funnel they lack.

competitors.howToWin: Sell brands direct-citation visibility in ChatGPT/Perplexity so they're less dependent on marketplace rankings and listing fees.
